papers.title: On-Policy or Off-Policy Learning? A Systematic Study of Distillation Dynamics
papers.desc: On-policy learning has been argued to reduce catastrophic forgetting, produce sparser parameter updates, and improve generalisation.

papers.title: Architect-Ant: Editable Automatic Furnishing of Architectural Floor Plans
papers.desc: Furnished floor plans support real-estate visualization, interior design, and architectural workflows, yet automatic furnishing remains challenged by limited real-world data and the need to satisfy interacting geometric and functional constraints.

papers.title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free
papers.desc: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops.

papers.title: Where-OPD: Spatially Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation of MLLMs with Synthetic Scenes
papers.desc: On-policy self-distillation has recently emerged as an effective approach for improving language-model reasoning by supervising students with a frozen or EMA version of themselves that receives privileged information.

papers.title: OpenTumorBoard: A Real-World Benchmark of Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Discussion Trajectories
papers.desc: Multidisciplinary tumor boards integrate multimodal clinical observations and longitudinal patient histories through specialist discussions, yet benchmarks rarely capture these real-world trajectories.

papers.title: RLE-Bench: A Qualifying Exam for Coding Agents as Robot Learning Engineers
papers.desc: Coding agents are beginning to move beyond purely digital tasks to tackle physical-world challenges, particularly in robotics.

papers.title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.desc: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models.

papers.title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models
papers.desc: When a camera revisits a previously observed region, a video world model should reproduce what was there before.

papers.title: X-Tree: Tokenizing Reusable Experience for Efficient Agent Generalization
papers.desc: Multi-step agents are trained on flat action streams: SFT and RLVR weight every token uniformly and ignore the sub-procedures that recur across tasks, the hierarchy that lets humans plan top-down from reusable routines.

papers.title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research
papers.desc: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs.

papers.title: OTRetarget: Joint Robot and Object Motion Retargeting via Optimal Transport
papers.desc: Transferring human motion to humanoid robots requires adapting the demonstrated motion to the robot morphology while preserving interactions with the environment.

papers.title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models
papers.desc: Video world models require persistent scene memory to maintain consistency during long-horizon video generation.

papers.title: JevSpawn: Adaptive Agentic Inference through Compositional Action Spaces
papers.desc: LLM agents generate intermediate reasoning and actions token by token, making extended interactions slow and computationally expensive.

papers.title: When Does Correction Become Repair? Mechanistic Auditing of Internal Interventions in Tool-Using LLMs
papers.desc: Before invoking external tools, an agentic LLM must select among a K-way action space: executing a call, seeking clarification, answering directly, or declining.

papers.title: Keyword Harnesses Fail Open: A Cheap Diagnostic Ladder for Tool-Use Claims in Small Language Models
papers.desc: Keyword-matching benchmarks can credit small models for tool use they never perform.
